stage: blind independent second reading, saved before comparison

workflow.layout: Whole source viewed once to inspect the layout. The prose and formulas are approximately horizontal; all 18 prepared crops were then visually inspected.
workflow.preparation: prepare_second.py 086 was run once with no rotation. No generated crop was replaced or regenerated.
workflow.comparison: No witness, first.tsv, first-reading report, approved page, draft, root notes or decisions, other leaf, or comparison output was opened. No comparison was run.

content_summary: The visible passages concern U as the complement of T in X, sections, an induced map from an inertia group, and a composite of group maps. Later text refers to a decomposition group, an exact sequence numbered (7), and a fundamental group associated with a quoted rondelle trouée and a henselization. This is a source-content summary, not a proof check.

boxes.scope: Whole visible formula fragment and sur.
boxes.evidence: U is followed by two compact vertically separated ink marks with faint short leftward tails. X and T are separated by a plain oblique subtraction dash. Sur follows.
uncertainties: The compact separator is provisionally an equality sign because both members have short horizontal tails, but a colon remains possible.

boxes.scope: Complete visible suppose, the following word, and une.
boxes.evidence: The two long descending strokes support pp in suppose. The next word has a tall looped d, low successive strokes, and an independently raised accent over its ending. Une has the expected low succession of curves.
uncertainties: The last tiny low trace after the accented ending may be another e. donné is preferred from the visible extent, with donnée retained.

boxes.scope: The beginning is the line-break suffix nelle; the complete following formula-bearing phrase is included.
boxes.evidence: The suffix has two tall l strokes. The f has a tall stem, long crossbar and lower return; the crossbar is read as part of f rather than a cancellation. De U sur S and the final comma are visible.

boxes.scope: s, de, one cancelled word, codim, and handwritten 1.
boxes.evidence: The small s precedes de. A dark horizontal cancellation runs across a short word whose first rounded strokes can be read as co; the remaining low strokes are obscured. The subsequent codim is clear and has an independent i dot; 1 has a base stroke.
uncertainties: The cancelled word is only provisionally codim. Its middle and final strokes cannot be recovered with certainty, so the whole deleted word remains marked doubtful.

boxes.scope: Complete visible avec, indexed symbol, contracted tt, and que.
boxes.evidence: Avec has low separated strokes. The indexed symbol has a small upper loop and long looped descender; its index includes a dotted i and a small rounded 0. The abbreviation after en has two upright strokes with a common transverse member, followed by que.
uncertainties: The g form is compressed here; the reading uses the same-page looped g forms visible independently in B016 and B017 as stroke controls. The abbreviation tt is preserved without expansion or supplied stop.

boxes.scope: Complete principal phrase; a small lower-edge fragment from the next line is excluded.
boxes.evidence: A looped l and separate apostrophe precede hom. No independent stop follows hom. Induit has a dotted i, a tall looped d, and a crossed terminal t.

boxes.scope: Complete group-inclusion fragment including both visible layers of the overwritten subscript.
boxes.evidence: I has top and bottom bars; its lower s has a separate prime. The inclusion sign has a curved upper member and long lower member, with no independent equality bar. At E the dark new subscript has the stem and two arms of K; lighter rounded strokes and a small upper trace remain under it.
uncertainties: The underlying overwritten subscript is tentatively s prime, but both its exact letter and prime are insecure. The TSV represents the old and new layers with deleted and inserted macros; they occupy the same physical position rather than being successive subscripts.

boxes.evidence: The first connector has a clear two-wing right arrowhead. The second is a plain horizontal shaft with only a small dark terminal deposit, not a separate pair of arrow wings. The middle index contains a large U with a smaller lower u; the final index is U.
uncertainties: The smaller u is a narrow two-stroke form, but no separate eta-like descending branch is established. The shaft is represented by a mathematical dash and is not converted into an arrow.

boxes.scope: Complete short form, dans, kernel-like expression, and comma. The clipped stroke entering from above is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The initial form has two horizontal levels; the lower begins with a curved return but has no distinct sequence of letter humps. The next word has a looped d and low continuation. The following capital-like stem has low oblique branches followed by two small letter shapes, provisionally Ker. L has a tall upright and right foot, followed by dotted i and a comma.
uncertainties: Equality is preferred for the initial form, with barred m retained as an alternative; the abbreviation is not expanded.
Ker remains doubtful because its first letter and low middle are compressed.

boxes.scope: Complete principal fragment; a curved trace clipped by the upper edge is excluded.
boxes.evidence: On is abbreviated in stroke extent but has a small rounded onset and following low stroke. The looped l, apostrophe, separate a, and vu are visible before a large closing parenthesis.

boxes.scope: Complete cancelled word, following sentence ending, and new clause.
boxes.evidence: A continuous strike crosses the low letters of nulle while two tall l strokes remain. Triviale is live and ends with a separate stop. Considérons has visible i dot and accent, followed by alors.
uncertainties: The cancelled word is retained as doubtful because its first two low letters are partly merged with the strike.

boxes.scope: Complete reference phrase, including handwritten number and comma. Clipped descenders at the top are excluded.
boxes.evidence: Cf has a large C and a following f-like stem; there is no separate point after it. Suite and exacte are legible. The parenthesized numeral has the top curve, descending stroke and crossbar of 7; a comma follows the closing parenthesis.

boxes.scope: Complete de la and quoted phrase. Clipped preceding-line ink at the top is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The quote marks stand independently above the line on both sides. Rondelle has a low r/o onset, a flattened n, a tall d, and two l stems. Trouée has a crossed t, low middle strokes, and a raised accent near its ending.

boxes.scope: Both principal bottom lines, through the final visible word; only isolated clipped marks from the preceding line are excluded.
boxes.evidence: Au hensélisé is followed by a complete parenthetical pas strict. De la precedes a word with a descending initial, low middle and looped later letter, provisionally jauge. The second line begins with underlined O and a two-part lower index separated by a comma, then a plain dash, ou mieux, le, pi with lower 1, and du générique. No terminal stop is established.
uncertainties: Jauge remains doubtful because its initial dot and several low joins are faint.
The first part of the O index is provisionally uppercase S, but lowercase s is retained as an alternative; the second part is s.

boxes.evidence: Two-loop 8 followed by 5 with upper horizontal, angled middle, and lower curve.

boxes.scope: Whole visible equality and following section phrase.
boxes.evidence: Both main symbols have looped upper portions and descending g-like strokes. The first index is dotted i; the second has dotted i plus a lower rounded 0. The equality has two clear short horizontal members. Section de T sur I follows; the last capital has a straight stem with top and bottom bars, and a comma follows.
uncertainties: The final base letter is transcribed I from its visible bar-stem-bar construction, without correcting it from context.

boxes.scope: Entire displayed equality, without supplied punctuation.
boxes.evidence: The initial symbol has an upper loop and lower looped descender with dotted i at its right. Both s arguments and parentheses are visible. The equality consists of two horizontal strokes. The f has a tall upper loop, lower loop, and long joining cross-stroke.

boxes.scope: Complete principal line from le through correspondant. Clipped preceding-line fragments are excluded.
boxes.evidence: Le precedes pi with a lower 1. The quoted rondelle trouée repeats the letters and quote marks read in B013. Correspondant has a descending p, later tall d, and low final sequence with terminal t; no stop follows.
